create_source_model_config: create a SourceModelBase subclass with a unique model_name to define a custom TORAX source configuration
register_source_model_config: register a custom source model config class against a source name to extend the TORAX Pydantic schema
build_source_from_config: build a Source object from a SourceModelBase config to compute source profiles at runtime
use_mode_enum: use the Mode enum to specify whether a TORAX source is ZERO, MODEL_BASED, or PRESCRIBED
merge_source_profiles: merge explicit and implicit SourceProfiles into a single combined profile collection
